_rules: This file is the definition of done. Sessions may only change the `passes` field.
Set passes=true only after the feature's acceptance test passes. The Stop hook re-runs every passes=true test.
Never edit backend/tests/acceptance/. If a test looks wrong, stop and say so.

features.description: FareSimulator(seed) implements both LiveFareProvider and CachedFareProvider; same seed gives identical tickets, different seeds give different prices.

Prices come from a hierarchical model (route level x date effect x weekday x noise). Saturdays cost more than Tuesdays on average; a return is cheaper than two one-ways; cached lowest prices are noisy but correlated with true lowest prices (r > 0.8).
exhaustive_best(sim, trip, prefs) searches the full candidate space without a budget and returns the best ScoredItinerary; no budgeted plan can beat it.

run_benchmark(planners, budgets, seeds, trips) returns one record per run with planner, trip, budget, seed, searches_used, best_utility, optimum_utility, regret, wall_ms. At least 10 benchmark trips. Deterministic.
`uv run python -m app.bench --planners heuristic --out <dir>` writes bench.json, bench.md (an ablation table with mean regret per planner and budget) and regret.png (regret against search budget).
The planner runs independent searches concurrently: with 50 ms simulated latency per search, a plan takes under half the serial time.

unsupported_numbers(text, tool_outputs) returns every money amount or duration in the LLM's answer that does not appear in tool outputs (rounded to the pound / the tenth of an hour). The agent loop sends unsupported numbers back to the model once and reports the rate.
Planner 'llm': the LLM chooses searches itself through a raw search tool under the same budget. run_benchmark accepts planners=['llm'] with an injected llm_factory.
Planner 'voi': a probabilistic fare model chooses searches by expected utility gain per search. Mean regret beats the heuristic planner at budgets 10 and 20 on the benchmark.
